newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-RAUL WINNER LIFTS REAL MADRID CLEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RAUL WINNER LIFTS REAL MADRID CLEAR.

text.p: Real Madrid striker Raul Gonzalez once again saved his side as the Spanish league leaders came back after conceding an early goal to gain a tough 3-2 victory at struggling Hercules on Sunday.
Raul's winner left Real a provisional eight points clear before Barcelona's game with Espanyol, which kicked off late.
Reigning champions Atletico Madrid also started badly but recovered in fine fashion to beat Compostela 4-1, while Real Betis secured third place with a 3-1 win over Extremadura.

Other UEFA Cup hopefuls slipped up. Real Sociedad are five points behind Betis after losing 1-0 to Valencia on Saturday but stayed in fourth place on goal difference because of Deportivo Coruna's 2-2 draw with Celta Vigo in the Galician derby.
Atletico are a further point back in sixth place but, with neighbours Real fully 16 points ahead, their chances of retaining the title are looking increasingly slim.
At the other end of the table former Argentine coach Carlos Bilardo was unable to make his debut on the bench for Sevilla because of league regulations.
Instead he directed his team by mobile phone from the stands but had to watch as fellow strugglers Zaragoza scored a late goal to win 2-1.
